name: Travel budget planner
audience: People pricing a short trip before they book.
summary: Build a trip cost from nights, daily food, transport, and a contingency percentage.
description: The sample is four nights in Cape Town for two adults travelling from Johannesburg. You can change every driver. Contingency is a percentage of the subtotal, not a guess typed at the end.
benefits: See the trip total and the cost per person
Keep a contingency that scales with the trip
Separate booked costs from daily spending
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
